cues.text: A hazy, pale yellow sun warms a rugged landscape of brown grass, scattered pines, and patches of melting snow.
Beside a massive tree with sprawling roots, three slender, four-legged creatures gather on rocky outcrops. They have long snouts, crested heads, and long, curved tails.
They look out over a vast lake toward towering rock formations. High above, the bright streak of a landing craft descends through the golden sky.

beats.note: A rugged boreal landscape with patches of snow, brown grass, and scattered pine trees under a hazy, pale yellow sky.
On the right, a massive tree with thick, exposed roots. Three slender, four-legged creatures with long snouts, crested heads, and curved tails stand nearby on rocky outcrops.
A bright streak of light appears in the upper left sky, descending toward the horizon.
The creatures look out over a vast, calm lake toward towering, sheer rock formations in the distance as the streak of light continues its descent.
